heading: Annual report

tree.heading: In General.—
tree.text: The corporation shall submit to Congress an annual report describing the activities of the corporation during the preceding fiscal year.

tree.heading: Submittal Date.—
tree.text: Each annual report under this section shall be submitted at the same time as the report of the audit of the corporation required by section 10101(b).

tree.heading: Report Not Public Document.—
tree.text: No annual report under this section shall be printed as a public document.

sourceCredit: (Added Pub. L. 118–31, div. E, title LI, § 5103(a), Dec. 22, 2023, 137 Stat. 938.)
